notes: Single file, no assets, no libraries. Canvas-rendered 5x9 lawn with DOM overlay menus: main menu, how-to-play, pause, game-over/victory screens, and a persistent top-10 leaderboard (localStorage, name/score/wave/date). 5 plants (sunflower, peashooter, snow pea, wall-nut with damage stages, cherry bomb with 3x3 blast), 3 zombie types (walker, conehead, buckethead) with eating/walking/death animation, 10 escalating waves with banners, sun economy (sky suns + sunflower production, click to collect), one lawnmower per lane, shovel dig-up, keyboard shortcuts (1-5, S, P/Esc), particles, floating score text, screen shake, and optional WebAudio synth SFX (no audio files). Verified headless (Node + DOM/canvas stubs): boot, start, 1100 simulated frames of gameplay (planting, shooting, zombie spawns, waves), menu navigation, and the leaderboard save path all ran without exceptions; main menu also visually confirmed in real Edge.
